items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 September 2026 10:04pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 19 September 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Norwegian Sea and high pressure near the Azores extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 late morning tomorrow, then 3 or 4 in the afternoon, backing west or southwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, soon backing south or southwest, then increasing 4 or 5 overnight into Monday. Decreasing 3 or 4 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle overnight into Monday, becoming fair late morning Monday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
